verdict.rationale: Warp documents typing '#' on the command line to describe a command in natural language, with AI Command Suggestions generated in real time in place (warp-docs-8, warp-docs-54, warp-docs-74). This extends to contextual suggestions inside interactive CLI tools like psql and git (warp-docs-75). A daily user independently praises having 'AI-generated commands at your fingertips' (warp-comm-13-refresh-3731890de967986f). missing for 10: the feature is labeled 'Generate (Legacy)', so its long-term status is unclear, and there is no hands-on evidence on how accurate the generated commands are.
